description: Test scenario 6c: four groups on floors 3-4 with a stair limit of 2 per wave. After the first wave, stair 2 on level 2 is blocked. Groups g1 and g2 are already below it and carry on; g3 and g4 are still above it and re-plan through stair 5, sharing its slots.
